name: Healthchecks
description: Your cron jobs and backups ping Healthchecks when they run; if a ping is late, you get alerted via email, Slack, Telegram and more.
compose:
services:
  healthchecks:
    image: healthchecks/healthchecks:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8000"
    environment:
      SITE_ROOT: "${{cfg.site_root}}"
      ALLOWED_HOSTS: "*"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
